notes: Morning = specialty library only (no seasons). Night = eggplant-purple awning storefront; outdoors + cart change by holiday/season/lighting. Full moon image ONLY on actual full-moon nights.

daytime.how_it_works: Specialty library images only. No seasonal or holiday overlays for morning posts.

nighttime.base_style: Sacred Ground exterior storefront vein: tan stone facade, deep EGGPLANT PURPLE awnings (building + cart — never blue), white SACRED GROUND lettering with NO swoosh/dash/ornament between the words (plain space only — never red, never gold), warm interior glow. Cart merchandise changes by holiday/season — not always crystals.
nighttime.awning_swoosh: none — leave blank eggplant space between SACRED and GROUND

full_moon.source_note: Dedicated full-moon storefront. Never use on non-full-moon nights.

nighttime.how_it_combines: Priority: (1) full moon night → full-moon image only; (2) holiday window → holiday outdoors + themed cart; (3) else season outdoors + seasonal cart + lighting. Awning always eggplant purple. Events stay in caption.
